caption: The drawing shows a detailed rendering of an andiron, primarily colored in shades of brown and gold, giving it a metallic, polished appearance. The central object has a large, spherical top set on a vertically elongated, turned central shaft, which is supported by a square base. From the base extend three curved legs that resemble clawed feet. Adjacent to the main structure, there is a horizontal support bar connected to a smaller, similarly styled sphere and post. In the upper left corner, there is a technical sketch of the same object drawn in a simpler style with fine black lines, also showing a scale in inches for measurement. The drawing is signed "HANS KORSCH" in the lower right corner. The background is plain and uncolored, bordered by a thin rectangular line.
title: Andiron (one of pair)
